notes.title: Bioframe's Ecosystem is TOO Dynamic?
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BhZfPKa_uUo;full][/previewyoutube]

In the first of many OSP developer deep dives, Rudolf investigates a problem created by the emergent and dynamic ecosystem of Bioframe Outpost.

When designing a game as dynamic as Bioframe, it was inevitable that eventually we would encounter some unexpected side effects, and in this video we take a close look at one of these unexpected outcomes and discuss the game design lessons that can be learned from it.
